name: OPD1 Command
purpose: Visual and UX reference for OPD1 Tracker. Stack, API contracts, and repository architecture remain governed by AGENTS.md and the source; when this file and the code disagree, the code wins.
identity: Deep blue-black tactical console: sharp geometry, thin accent spines, uppercase Bahnschrift display type, and real VALORANT artwork under muted matte gradients. Information leads; decoration stays under the data.

display.usage: Titles, section headings, scores, rank names, and big telemetry numerals. Often uppercase with 0.04-0.12em tracking.

ui.fontFamily: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
ui.usage: Body copy, labels, controls — and every telemetry number (K/D, WR, HS, RR). Numbers use this face with tabular figures for one consistent numeral style; Bahnschrift is reserved for headings and section titles.

mono.usage: Riot ID tags, RR/rating values, and precise telemetry that must not shift.

ascii.usage: ASCII Studio canvas, previews, and glyph pickers only.

accents.tailwind: bg-brand (white primary actions with ink text), text-accent/bg-accent (VALORANT red identity)

state.tailwind: text-ally, text-enemy, text-victory, text-defeat, text-draw, text-gold, text-warn

colors.notes: All color references in code are CSS variables under :root in frontend/src/styles/index.css; Tailwind names map to them. Rank and party colors always come from the data, never from the palette.

layout.shell: CommandBar (h-12) across the top with game-state, match context (map · mode only — the live score stays in the game), live/saved + last update, client, API, version; fixed 64px icon-rail Sidebar (expands to 216px on hover, pin persists in localStorage opd1:sidebar-pinned). No bottom status bar, no window controls: the Tauri window is locked to 1200×800 (min=max, resizable false) and cannot be maximized.
layout.live_match: MatchHeader command strip (map + mode, round + side chips, win probability meter labeled as an estimate; pregame lock segments; lobby queue strip) above the matchup board: two side-by-side TeamPanels, each a 3px team-accent spine, statistics header, party rail with detection coverage, and five vertically stacked rectangular player cards. The running score is intentionally NOT shown — the user is mid-match and sees it in game. The required 5v5 rectangular matchup must remain at 1200×800.
layout.player_card: Grid areas avatar | identity | rank | stats over a full-width 30px weapon loadout strip; player-card artwork behind a near-solid matte so all text is fully legible. Identity line 1 shows the FULL Riot ID (max 16+4 chars at the fixed size, never truncated in practice) plus hidden-name / saved / party chips; line 2 shows agent, level, seen count, streak, and compact icon-only smurf/boosting flags whose meaning is explained by hover/focus tooltips. No '5M' scope labels under the stats — the tooltips carry the sample scope.
layout.recent_form: Last-5 outcomes render oldest to newest, left to right, with progressively larger tiles; the newest (rightmost) tile is highlighted (data-recency=current, recent-form-tile-newest) with a chevron. Per-tile hover/focus tooltip shows Victory/Defeat, RR delta when available, and match age. 5M label makes the scope explicit.
layout.drawer: Centered dossier up to min(1120px, 100vw-32px), max-height 960px, with player-card artwork header, current rank, party/smurf/boosting/saved badges, Overview and Matches tabs (roving tabindex), independent scroll region, threat/streak alert band above the overview, and embedded match detail that preserves drafts and focus.
layout.card_density: Container queries on each team panel (440/520/760px) re-flow the player card columns; below 440px the rank and telemetry columns compress but the five rows stay.
layout.weapon_strip: Four featured slots — Vandal, Phantom, Operator, Sheriff (the sidearm replaces the old knife slot, which had no skin name of its own). Every slot shows the weapon name beside the skin image: skin image + weapon name + skin name, in both the compact in-card strip and the dossier grid. Missing loadouts render 'Unavailable'; standard weapons render as 'Standard'. Never invent a skin.

component_guidance.badges: Badge uses an explicit color prop; filled variants invert to ink text. OutcomeBadge: Win/Loss/Draw/Unresolved stay distinct; lg size with score uses mono numerals.
component_guidance.streaks: StreakBadge is neutral (text-text-secondary) with streak-w / streak-l testids; threat is never styled as a streak.
component_guidance.player_names: PlayerIdentity renders the tag in a separate mono span and truncates only the name; the full Riot ID stays in the profile opener accessible label and native title.
component_guidance.rank: Rank names use the data-provided color; icons are remote images with silent onError removal; unranked shows No RR.
component_guidance.lists: History, saved players, and competitive splits use the card/inset surface with micro-label column headers and mono numerals for telemetry.
component_guidance.drawers_modals: Match details render in a z-70 dialog modal in History and as embedded z-60 content in the drawer, sharing MatchDetailContent; exact vs estimated data and draw vs unresolved outcomes stay distinct.
component_guidance.ascii: ASCII Studio keeps the gallery/text/draw tab layout; outputs target VALORANT chat.
component_guidance.texture: Real VALORANT artwork only from media.valorant-api.com. contour.png is a generated decorative fallback for missing profile cards and never represents game data.
component_guidance.threats: Smurf and boosting are small tinted icon chips on the card's second identity line (smurf = accent, boosting = warning), never text that collides with the rank; tooltips list the heuristic reasons. Flags are heuristics, never confirmations.

motion.hover: transition-colors with --dur-fast; artwork brightens slightly on card hover.
motion.lists: Minimal; pulse-dot only for live states.
motion.reduced_motion: Respect motion-reduce utilities; no layout animation.

accessibility.interactive: Visible accent focus rings, collision-aware overlays, Escape/outside-click closing, focus restoration to the opener, role=meter for the win-chance estimate, sr-only summaries for form strips.
accessibility.html: Never nest interactive elements; the player card opens via one invisible full-surface button.

media.valorant_assets: Load VALORANT imagery only from media.valorant-api.com.
media.fonts: Use Windows system fonts; no runtime font requests.

design_notes_for_agents: Do not change the Flask backend for visual redesign work.
Every interactive element and key informational wrapper must have a data-testid.
Design Mode must remain guarded by import.meta.env.DEV.
Real data only; demo payloads must never be presented as live data.
Missing values render as unavailable states, never invented statistics.
The window is fixed at 1200×800 with no maximize/resize; design for that single size only.
Do not display the live in-match score anywhere in the tracker; the player sees it in game.
